mapper.select: SELECT AS time_bucket, r.channel_id, MAX(c.channel_name) AS channel_name, r.monitor_id, MAX(m.monitor_name) AS monitor_name, r.advertiser_id, MAX(a.advertiser_name) AS advertiser_name, r.app_link_id, MAX(l.link_name) AS app_link_name, COALESCE(MAX(d.ratio), 1.0000) AS deduction_ratio, SUM(r.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(r.clicks) AS clicks, CASE WHEN SUM(r.impressions) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(r.clicks) * 100.0 / SUM(r.impressions), 4) END AS click_rate, SUM(r.cost_amount) AS cost_amount, SUM(r.revenue_amount) AS revenue_amount, SUM(r.activate_count) AS activate_count, SUM(r.evoke_count) AS evoke_count, SUM(r.login_count) AS login_count, SUM(r.register_count) AS register_count, SUM(r.payment_count) AS payment_count, SUM(r.acquisition_count) AS acquisition_count, SUM(r.next_stay_count) AS next_stay_count, SUM(r.visit_count) AS visit_count, SUM(r.authentication_count) AS authentication_count, SUM(r.order_count) AS order_count, SUM(r.first_order_count) AS first_order_count, SUM(r.finish_order_count) AS finish_order_count, SUM(r.raw_conversion_count) AS raw_conversion_count, SUM(r.forwarded_conversion_count) AS forwarded_conversion_count, SUM(r.deducted_conversion_count) AS deducted_conversion_count, SUM(r.delivery_failure_count) AS delivery_failure_count FROM scx_adx_hourly_report r LEFT JOIN scx_adx_channel c ON c.id = r.channel_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN scx_adx_monitor_link m ON m.id = r.monitor_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN scx_adx_advertiser a ON a.id = r.advertiser_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN scx_adx_app_link l ON l.id = r.app_link_id AND l.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN scx_adx_deduction_rule d ON d.channel_id = r.channel_id AND d.app_link_id = r.app_link_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE r.time_hour >= #{start} AND r.time_hour < #{end} AND r.channel_id = #{channelId} AND r.monitor_id = #{monitorId} AND r.advertiser_id = #{advertiserId} AND r.app_link_id = #{appLinkId} GROUP BY , r.channel_id, r.monitor_id, r.advertiser_id, r.app_link_id ORDER BY DESC, MAX(c.channel_name), MAX(a.advertiser_name)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(time_hour, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reportDate, COALESCE(SUM(revenue_amount), 0) AS income FROM scx_adx_hourly_report WHERE time_hour >= #{start} AND advertiser_id = #{advertiserId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(time_hour, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY reportDate
